title: Orientation
description: auto follows the source's shape: one line in a flat box, a title line over a stars/mods/mapper line once the box is about 66 px tall or more, a column in an upright box. horizontal never uses the column; vertical always does.

title: Alignment
description: Which edge the line hugs inside the source; mirrors the column and its progress rule. auto centres it for osu! and catch and right-aligns it for taiko and mania, matching the suggested placements.

title: Backing
description: none floats the text on the game; scrim adds a soft dark wash that fades out at its edges; panel draws a graphite panel.

title: Accent
description: map tints the star and progress rule from the beatmap's background colours; 18-lab keeps the amber accent.

title: Original-language metadata
description: Show artist and title in their original script when the map provides it; otherwise the romanised fields are used.

title: Star rating
description: Star rating with the active mods applied.

title: Mods
description: Mods of the current play. Hidden when no mods are active.

title: Long lines
description: marquee scrolls a title line that does not fit, pausing at both ends; truncate ends it with an ellipsis. Lines that fit never move. The column wraps instead.
